name: DSE2548 LED annunciator module
summary: Remote LED annunciator position and panel-face coordination.
description: Place the vertical annunciator where its indications and alarm-mute control can be reached. Provide rear access to supply and host-network wiring without obstructing adjacent devices.

The linked CAD resource is an electrical wiring reference. Use the separate manufacturer installation drawing for physical dimensions; this original unitless GA illustration is not a fabrication template.

This module provides host-controlled indication; it does not replace the main generator controller.
